newsitem.title: USA: PJ America acquires 8 Papa John's.
newsitem.headline: PJ America acquires 8 Papa John's.

text.p: PJ America Inc on Thursday said it acquired eight Papa John's Pizza restaurants from Ohio Pizza Delivery Co Inc.
The company said the acquisition should add to its third-quarter earnings. Financial terms were not disclosed.
The company, the largest franchisee of Papa John's International Inc, said the restaurants are in the Akron, Ohio, area.
The deal will be accounted for as a pooling-of-interests, it said.
"We are excited to have completed this acquisition and begin our presence in Ohio," PJ America President and Chief Executive Doug Stephens said in a statement.
In addition to the Ohio outlets, PJ America operates 58 restaurants in Alabama, Virginia and Texas. The company is based in Birmingham, Alabama.
PJ America shares closed off 1/8 at 17.
